name: GitHub
description: GitHub lets agents review pull requests, open and triage issues, search code, and manage releases in the repositories a personal access token can reach. The token stays on this computer and travels as one Authorization header.

prompts.text: Review my open pull requests and flag the riskiest one.
What issues were opened against my repos this week?
Draft release notes from merged pull requests since the last tag.

apps.name: GitHub
apps.description: Issues, pull requests, code search, and releases, over GitHub's remote MCP server with a personal access token.

fields.label: Personal access token
fields.hint: GitHub Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens
